THE CHINA PRESS, TUESDAY, JANUARY 5, 1932
REGISTRY
S. B. D. 7052
6. 1. 32.

Modern Scotland Yard Of Shanghai
Makes Things “Hot” For City Gangsters

New Scientific Technique
Used In Criminal
Apprehension

By PAT McGRADY
(China Press Staff Writer)

What with scientific stuff and new fangled ideas creeping into police work, it’s getting so a good crook can’t make a decent living. The above is a common complaint among members of Shanghai’s lawless fraternity. Recent innovations introduced in International Settlement police work, have made many knights of the gun, blackjack, and mask, and all their ilk look to other fields for less precarious means of livelihood.

Where Work Begins

The layman, whose knowledge of police work includes only that gleaned from witnessing brawls, or an occasional more serious malefactor, being ignominiously led by a burly minion of the law in the direction of the station house, is grossly ignorant of the intricate workings of the body that affords comparatively air tight protection to residents of the International Settlement. It has been truly said that the police are psychic in their analysis of crime and detection of criminals. Where the layman’s observations end, police work really begins. The machinations of science, delicate in detail and too convincing for argument in summing up crime and placing blame where it rightfully belongs, are fighting a winning, one-sided battle against illicit gentry, from the moronic to genial classes.

With the interlocking nature of police activities, the absorption of one department by a second, and that in turn by a third, and the innumerable avenues of intelligence connecting each unit of the entire system with every other function of the police, it is difficult to begin at any logical beginning and proceed in any orderly fashion through the maze of facts, figures and data comprising the police machine.

One can take any number of angles from which to view the vast network of intelligence that makes up the police system. Perhaps the best way to approach the subject is to consider the various departments separately, and then show how they are interrelated.

First, there is the Identification Bureau, which maintains records of all known criminals in the Settlement. This bureau is responsible for the classification and filing of fingerprints, photographs, and other identifying data. It also handles the registration of aliens and the issuance of identity cards.

Second, there is the Criminal Investigation Department (C.I.D.), which is responsible for the investigation of serious crimes such as murder, robbery, and fraud. The C.I.D. works closely with the Identification Bureau to identify suspects and gather evidence.

Third, there is the Uniformed Branch, which provides visible policing and maintains public order. The uniformed officers are often the first to respond to incidents and provide initial reports to the C.I.D.

Fourth, there is the Traffic Branch, which is responsible for regulating traffic and enforcing traffic laws. This branch also handles accidents and ensures the smooth flow of vehicles and pedestrians.

Fifth, there is the Special Branch, which deals with political matters and internal security. This branch monitors subversive activities and protects vital installations.

Sixth, there is the Wireless Branch, which handles communications between police stations and units. This branch ensures that information is transmitted quickly and efficiently.

Seventh, there is the Laboratory, which provides scientific support to investigations. The laboratory analyzes evidence such as blood, fibers, and chemicals to help solve crimes.

Eighth, there is the Training School, which prepares new recruits for service. The school teaches law, procedure, and practical skills necessary for effective policing.

Ninth, there is the Welfare Section, which looks after the well-being of police officers and their families. This section provides medical care, housing, and other benefits.

Tenth, there is the Public Relations Office, which communicates with the media and the public. This office aims to build trust and cooperation between the police and the community.

These ten branches form the backbone of the Shanghai Municipal Police. Each branch has its own specific duties, but they all work together to maintain law and order in the International Settlement.

With these two characteristics known, the unknown quantities could easily be recognized from the criminal biographies that line shelves in police headquarters.

Catalogues Maintained

Catalogues are also maintained covering such details as: teeth—missing, protruding, gold, etc.....; body deformities.....low shoulder, twisted hip, etc. .....; nose.....broken, Roman, arched, etc. .....; speech ..... dialect, stutter, stammer, .....; pockmarks; tattoo marks; names and aliases; clothing; asserted profession; and all conceivable details that might mark a man from the rest of humanity. It requires only a few known quantities to give the police hint as to the identity of the man; the unknowns are all found in the suspect’s personal biography, which is maintained in utmost detail, including pictures, in another section of the catalogue.

Unmentioned in the above, yet so important a classification that it in itself is a long story, is the category of methods of “pulling” a job. Detectives gather evidence showing that criminals are schooled in a certain way of operating, and that they seldom deviate from this method. It is true that certain burglars will elect to climb a drain in preference to walking through an open door. It is their way of working, and they are bound to stick to it. Because of this fact, a large number of crimes may be traced to a certain criminal because of his individualistic way of operating. Through their records police may successfully accuse an offender of perpetrating a series of similar offenses.

Information Recorded

Old detectives who could put two and two together and get five, were invaluable assets to the force. They knew the streets, the people, and the tricks of the trade. Their experience was often more valuable than any scientific instrument. However, with the advent of modern techniques, even the most seasoned detective must adapt to new methods.

The police now use a variety of tools to aid in their investigations. These include fingerprinting, photography, and chemical analysis. Fingerprinting has revolutionized the identification of criminals. No two fingerprints are alike, making them a reliable means of identification. Photography allows for the visual documentation of crime scenes and suspects. Chemical analysis helps in determining the composition of substances found at crime scenes.

In addition to these tools, the police also rely on informants and undercover agents. Informants provide valuable tips and insights into criminal activities. Undercover agents infiltrate criminal organizations to gather intelligence from within.

The combination of traditional detective work and modern scientific techniques has made the Shanghai Municipal Police one of the most effective forces in the world. They continue to evolve and adapt to new challenges, ensuring the safety and security of the International Settlement.

Interesting Rackets

A number of interesting “rackets” are recorded in the catalogue. Police have little doubt but that time will deliver the authors of these frauds into their hands. Many games have undeniable elements of humor. A like number portray a pathetic side of gullible farmer lads, who have come to the city to make good and are duped out of their worldly possessions during their first day of metropolitan existence. Widows and orphans too add to receipts of modern Chinese dupesters that prevail in all parts of Shanghai. According to the number of successful shady enterprises in Shanghai, Pagan, the Artful Dodger, and all their band would find this a happy hunting ground.

There is the “telephone man.” He is a wise thief. There are 36 cases on record wherein this individual has come to foreign and Chinese homes to “inspect” the telephone. “Just a monthly check-up,” he explains as he takes down the receiver and tinkers with the instrument. Invariably he discovers something wrong with the telephone, and upon his promise to install a better instrument of newer design, the telephone subscriber is usually only too glad to allow him to remove the phone and walk away with it. Often his demand for $1 cumsha for the service is met. Although he explains that his partner will follow up within a half hour with a new telephone, none has ever been recorded as having been installed.

“Gas Man” Stunt

The “gas man” works a similar racket. He comes to inspect gas appliances. After tinkering with the system for a brief period, he makes away with all the salable fittings.

There are the duo who manipulate a wallet at considerable gain. One drops the wallet; his companion picks it up and urges an innocent bystander to “see if anything is missing.” The wallet is opened, and the contents are examined. The owner claims that money is missing, and the bystander is accused of theft. The bystander, eager to clear his name, often pays a sum to settle the matter. The duo then splits the proceeds.

Another common racket involves the sale of fake goods. Vendors sell counterfeit items at inflated prices, preying on the unsuspecting. These items range from jewelry to electronics. The police regularly raid markets and shops to confiscate these goods and arrest the vendors.

Yet another racket involves the manipulation of weights and measures. Merchants use rigged scales to shortchange customers. The police conduct regular inspections to ensure fair trade practices.

The police also deal with gambling dens and opium houses. These establishments operate illegally and contribute to social decay. Raids are conducted periodically to shut them down and arrest those involved.

Prostitution is another area of concern. The police work to suppress brothels and protect victims of trafficking. Efforts are made to rehabilitate those involved and provide them with alternative livelihoods.

The police also address issues related to labor disputes and strikes. They mediate between workers and employers to prevent violence and maintain industrial peace.

In summary, the Shanghai Municipal Police face a wide array of challenges. From petty theft to organized crime, they strive to uphold the law and protect the community. Their efforts are commendable, and they continue to adapt to the changing landscape of crime in the city.

《字林西报》，1932年1月5日，星期二
登记处
S. B. D. 7052
32.1.6.

上海的现代苏格兰场
让城市黑帮日子“难过”

抓捕罪犯采用
新型科学手段

帕特·麦格拉迪（PAT McGRADY）撰
（《字林西报》特约记者）

随着科学装备和新奇观念逐渐渗入警务工作，如今连高明的窃贼都难以维持体面的生计。以上是上海不法之徒圈子里常见的抱怨。近期引入公共租界警务工作的创新举措，使得许多手持枪支、短棍和面具的“骑士”及其同伙，不得不转向其他领域，寻求不那么朝不保夕的生计。

工作始于何处

外行人士对警务工作的了解，仅限于目睹斗殴，或偶尔看到较为严重的罪犯被一名魁梧的执法爪牙羞辱性地押往警局，他们对为公共租界居民提供近乎密不透风保护的这一机构的复杂运作机制可谓一无所知。人们常说，警方在分析犯罪和侦缉罪犯方面具有直觉般的敏锐力。外行的观察止步之处，正是警务工作真正开始之地。科学手段的运用，细节精微，且在总结罪行和归咎责任时具有不容辩驳的说服力，正在这场针对非法之徒（从愚笨之辈到圆滑之流）的战斗中，赢得一场一边倒的胜利。

鉴于警务活动相互交织的性质——一个部门的工作由第二个部门承接，继而再由第三个部门接手，以及无数情报渠道将整个系统的每个单元与警方的其他各项职能相连——要想从某个逻辑起点入手，并有序地穿越构成警察机器的迷宫般的事实、数字和数据，实属困难。

人们可以从多个角度来审视构成警察系统的庞大情报网络。或许探讨这一主题的最佳方式是分别考察各个部门，然后展示它们之间的相互关联。

首先是指纹识别局（Identification Bureau），该局保存着租界内所有已知罪犯的记录。该局负责指纹、照片及其他身份识别数据的分类和归档。它还负责外籍人士的登记及身份证件的签发。

其次是刑事调查处（C.I.D.），负责调查谋杀、抢劫和诈骗等严重犯罪。刑事调查处与指纹识别局密切合作，以识别嫌疑人并收集证据。

第三是制服巡捕房（Uniformed Branch），负责提供可见的警力部署并维护公共秩序。制服巡捕往往是首批响应事件的人员，并向刑事调查处提供初步报告。

第四是交通处（Traffic Branch），负责监管交通并执行交通法规。该处还处理交通事故，确保车辆和行人通行顺畅。

第五是政治部（Special Branch），负责处理政治事务和内部安全。该部门监控颠覆活动并保护重要设施。

第六是无线电台处（Wireless Branch），负责各警局和单位之间的通信联络。该处确保信息快速高效地传输。

第七是实验室（Laboratory），为调查提供科学支持。实验室分析血液、纤维和化学品等证据，以帮助破案。

第八是训练学校（Training School），为新 recruits（新员）提供服务前的准备。学校教授法律、程序以及有效警务工作所需的实用技能。

第九是福利科（Welfare Section），负责照顾警员及其家属的福祉。该科提供医疗护理、住房及其他福利。

第十是公共关系办公室（Public Relations Office），负责与媒体和公众沟通。该办公室旨在建立警方与社区之间的信任与合作。

这十个分支构成了上海公共租界工部局警务处的骨干。每个分支都有其特定的职责，但它们共同努力，以维护公共租界的法律与秩序。

根据右脸颊疤痕和右腿跛行等分类，可以通过个人履历进行追踪，其中对每名罪犯都有详尽的描述。一旦掌握这两个特征，便可以从警察总局书架上排列的罪犯传记中轻易识别出那些未知身份者。

保持目录记录

此外，还维护着涵盖以下细节的目录：牙齿——缺失、突出、金牙等；身体畸形——溜肩、髋部扭曲等；鼻子——骨折、罗马鼻、拱形鼻等；言语——方言、口吃、结巴等；痘痕；纹身；姓名及别名；衣着；声称的职业；以及所有可能将某人与众区分开来的 conceivable（可想象到的）细节。只需几个已知量，就能给警方提供关于该人身份的线索；所有未知量均可在嫌疑人的个人传记中找到，该传记保存在目录的另一部分，包含照片，且记录极为详尽。

上述内容未提及，但本身就是一个长篇故事的重要分类，是“作案手法”类别。侦探们收集的证据显示，罪犯受过某种特定操作方式的训练，且很少偏离这种方法。确实，某些窃贼会选择攀爬排水管，而不愿穿过敞开的门。这是他们的行事方式，他们必然会坚持这样做。基于这一事实，由于某名罪犯独特的作案方式，大量犯罪案件可以追溯到该人身上。通过其记录，警方可以成功指控一名罪犯犯下一系列类似罪行。

记录信息

那些能够举一反三的老侦探是警队的宝贵资产。他们熟悉街道、人群以及行当里的 tricks（伎俩）。他们的经验往往比任何科学仪器都更有价值。然而，随着现代技术的出现，即使是最经验丰富的侦探也必须适应新方法。

警方现在使用各种工具辅助调查。这些包括指纹识别、摄影和化学分析。指纹识别彻底改变了罪犯的身份鉴定方式。没有两个指纹是相同的，使其成为可靠的识别手段。摄影允许对犯罪现场和嫌疑人进行视觉记录。化学分析有助于确定在犯罪现场发现的物质的成分。

除了这些工具，警方还依赖线人和卧底特工。线人提供有关犯罪活动的宝贵提示和见解。卧底特工渗透进犯罪组织，从内部收集情报。

传统侦探工作与现代科学技术的结合，使上海公共租界工部局警务处成为世界上最有效的警力之一。他们不断演变并适应新的挑战，以确保公共租界的安全与保障。

有趣的骗局

目录中记录了许多有趣的“骗局”。警方毫不怀疑，时间会将这些欺诈行为的始作俑者送入他们手中。许多把戏带有不可否认的幽默元素。同样数量的案例描绘了容易上当的农村青年可悲的一面，他们来到城市想要闯出一番事业，却在都市生活的第一天就被骗走了全部家当。寡妇和孤儿也增加了盛行于上海各地的现代中国骗子的收入。根据上海成功 shady（阴暗/非法）企业的数量来看，《雾都孤儿》中的费金（Fagin）、机灵鬼（Artful Dodger）及其团伙会发现这里是一个快乐的猎场。

有一种“电话修理工”。他是一个聪明的窃贼。记录中有36起案件，此人进入外国人和中国人的家中“检查”电话。“只是每月例行检查，”他一边解释，一边取下听摆弄仪器。他总是发现电话有问题，并承诺安装一款设计更新的更好仪器，电话用户通常非常乐意让他拆走电话并携之离去。通常，他对服务收取1美元酬谢的要求会得到满足。虽然他解释说他的合伙人会在半小时内带着新电话跟进，但从未有记录显示有新电话被安装。

“煤气工”伎俩

“煤气工”实施类似的骗局。他来检查煤气器具。在短暂摆弄系统后，他卷走所有可出售的配件。

还有两人搭档操纵钱包以获取可观收益。一人掉落钱包；同伴捡起钱包，并怂恿无辜旁观者“看看是否少了东西”。钱包被打开，内容物被检查。失主声称钱款丢失，并指责旁观者盗窃。旁观者急于洗清嫌疑，往往支付一笔款项以解决此事。随后两人瓜分所得。

另一种常见骗局涉及销售假冒商品。小贩以抬高价格出售 counterfeit（伪造）物品，利用 unsuspecting（毫无戒心）的人。这些物品范围从珠宝到电子产品。警方定期突击市场 and shops（商店），没收这些商品并逮捕小贩。

还有一种骗局涉及操纵度量衡。商人使用做手脚的秤来 shortchange（少找零/克扣）顾客。警方进行定期检查以确保公平贸易实践。

警方还打击赌博窝点和鸦片馆。这些场所非法经营，助长社会腐败。警方定期进行突袭以关闭这些场所并逮捕相关人员。

卖淫是另一个关注领域。警方致力于取缔妓院并保护人口贩卖的受害者。各方努力使涉案人员改过自新，并为她们提供替代生计。

警方还处理与劳资纠纷和罢工有关的问题。他们在工人和雇主之间进行调解，以防止暴力并维持工业和平。

总之，上海公共租界工部局警务处面临各种各样的挑战。从 petty theft（轻微盗窃）到有组织犯罪，他们努力维护法律并保护社区。他们的努力值得称赞，并且他们继续适应城市中不断变化的犯罪形势。

“My wife will wait outside until I
return,” he states pointing to the
doctor. “If the goods are satis-
factory, I will bring the money
from my friend to pay for them,”
he adds. The man asks the doctor
to wait for a moment, and neither
he nor the goods is seen again.

Another city slicker approaches a
fairly well dressed Chinese woman
and informs her that there is a
job open for an amah. The posi-
tion invariably pays an attractive
salary. “You are too well dressed,
however,” the stranger informs the
woman. “Perhaps you had better
leave your wraps and things with
me, while you go inside the build-
ing to apply for the job.” The
woman proceeds to a certain room
in the building designated, learns
that they have no need of an
amah, and returns to find the
stranger and her property gone.

There is the one-eyed youth,
who makes a practise of ordering
flowers to be delivered at a build-
ing by cycle coolie. He meets the
coolie, tells him to go upstairs and
leave the flowers in a certain room,
and while the coolie is gone, the
stranger absconds with the bicycle,
which is usually valued at about
$50.

Buyers Of Notes

Women have proven ready buyers
of $50 notes. They are usually sold
for about $16 cash and are later
discovered to be “joss notes.”

One may well conjecture as to
what happens to youths met on
Ningpo Road who deliver their
bundles to strangers to hold, while
they go to a nearby shop for
cigarettes. They are usually pro-
mised a few coppers for the service.

Apprentices have proven a God-
send to artful deceivers. There is
the ever-recurring example of the
man who stops apprentices on their
way out of banks and informs the
latter that the notes they carry have
depreciated in value. The stranger
leads these boys to another bank
where, he says, the value may be
given for the notes, and after a
long talk with the cashier, of which
the youth hears not a word, the
youth is steered to a place where
he can buy a 12 cent tax stamp
necessary for the transaction, in
which the notes are to be given full
value. On the way the very ob-
liging stranger, who in negotiating
for the full value of the note, has
taken over the money, sends the
boy across the street for cigarettes.
The answer is easy.

The showman and his Buddha
that gives immortality is well
known. He promises that his woo-
den image of Buddha will double all
money placed in the figure’s pos-
session. The showman takes the
money offered, wraps it into a
small bundle, and places it inside
the image. A few gesticulations
and ejaculations and it’s practically
all over. The small wad is handed
the owner, and, true enough, it is
approximately double its original
size. The owner is instructed to
take the packet home, put it away
for a half hour, and then open it.
The wad is invariably blank paper.

“我妻子会在外面等候，直到我回来，”他指着那位医生说道。“如果货物令人满意，我会从我朋友那里取钱来支付货款，”他补充道。那人请医生稍候片刻，随后此人连同货物便再无踪影。

另一名城市老手接近一位衣着相当体面的中国妇女，告知她有一个保姆（amah）的空缺职位。该职位 invariably 提供诱人的薪水。“不过，您穿得太过体面了，”陌生人告诉该妇女。“也许您最好将您的外套及随身物品交给我保管，同时您进入楼内申请这份工作。”该妇女前往指定的楼内某房间，得知他们并不需要保姆，返回时却发现陌生人和她的财物已不见踪影。

还有一个独眼青年，惯常做法是叫人力车夫骑车将鲜花送至某建筑物。他遇见车夫，吩咐其上楼将花留在某个房间，趁车夫离开之际，这名陌生人便携自行车潜逃，该车通常价值约50元。

钞票买家

女性已被证实是50元面额钞票的乐意购买者。这些钞票通常以约16元现金出售，后来被发现是“冥币”（joss notes）。

人们不难推测，在宁波路（Ningpo Road）上遇到的那些青年遭遇了什么：他们将包裹交给陌生人保管，自己则去附近商店买香烟。作为服务报酬，他们通常被许诺得到几枚铜板。

学徒已被证明是狡猾骗子的天赐猎物。屡见不鲜的例子是，有人拦住刚从银行出来的学徒，告知后者他们所携带的钞票已贬值。陌生人将这些少年带到另一家银行，称在那里可以按面值兑换钞票，在与出纳员进行 lengthy 交谈后——青年对此一言未闻——青年被引导至一处购买交易所需的12分印花税票的地方，以便使钞票获得全额价值。途中，这位在协商钞票全额价值过程中已接管钱款的、极为殷勤的陌生人，派少年过街去买香烟。答案显而易见。

那位表演者及其赐予永生的佛像广为人知。他承诺，凡放入佛像手中的钱财均会翻倍。表演者收下所献之钱，将其包成一个小包裹，并放入佛像内部。经过一番手势和喊叫，事情便基本结束。那小捆东西被交还给物主，的确，其体积大约比原来大了一倍。物主被指示将包裹带回家，放置半小时，然后打开。那捆东西 invariably 是白纸。
